result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, but the horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel clips the third restaurant card at the screen edge, truncating its name and delivery fee, which suggests a missing right padding or scroll affordance. A couple of minor polish items are also noted.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen; its name and delivery fee are truncated. The carousel also lacks a visible scroll indicator suggesting more content exists.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding so partially visible cards peek intentionally and remain readable, or add a scroll hint (e.g., partial next card plus fade/indicator) to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: White time-badge text ('15-25 min', etc.) sits directly over busy food imagery; contrast is not guaranteed and may fail WCAG AA on lighter images (e.g., the white plate in the first card).
issues.suggestion: Give badges a solid or semi-opaque dark background with sufficient contrast, rather than relying on the image underneath.

issues.description: The 'Profile' tab is highlighted in green while on the Home feed, which may confuse users about their current screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the active tab reflects the current screen (Home should be highlighted here), or verify navigation state is correct.
